title: 第九章 你看清楚，我不是苏苒
slug: 和情敌共感后傲娇竹马火葬场了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

不想让薄璟琛知道她跟霍宴年的事，倒不是因为她心虚。

甚至一开始，她都没有跟这男人隐瞒的意思，但凡他有心，随便去调查一下，都能知道那天晚上她根本就没有从霍宴年的房里出来。

可是，偏偏眼前的人那么自信笃定，觉得她一定不会接纳除了他以外的人。

紧攥着她手腕的大手灼热。

仿佛在提醒着她，薄璟琛这莫名其妙的人，发起疯来有多可怕。

在顺利解除婚约之前，她不想再因为这些无名事，激怒他，再平生祸端了。

“薄璟琛！你看清楚，我不是苏苒。”

夏暮强压着胸腔里剧烈的心跳。

她听见自己故作镇定的声音，依旧由于着急，带上了几分颤。

似乎是苏苒的名字太过管用。

夏暮话音落下，薄璟琛正在拽她衣领的动作，停顿在了原地。

但很快，他重新反应过来，逐渐朝她凑近。

大手扣住她的脖颈，迫使她一直抬眼，与他四目相对。

她眼睁睁地看着这张，无数次出现在她梦境的脸，朝自己逼近。

距离近到，鼻尖快要蹭到她的鼻尖。

即使她对眼前的人，已经彻底死心。

可逐渐侵染鼻腔的阵阵薄荷气息，霸道强势依旧，将她的回忆拉扯回了曾经的日夜。

夏暮屏住了呼吸，刚想用尽最后的一丝理智，推开眼神愈发阴沉的薄璟琛。

没来得及等她动作。

这一次，薄璟琛先冷笑着开口，“你是不是觉得，我送你回家一次，你就有底气跟我叫板了？”

好听喑哑的男声，化作最锋利的刃，狠狠刺进她的心脏处。

短短的一句话，足以让人从暖春，坠入万劫不复的深冬。

“薄璟琛，你这样，会让我以为你真的爱上我了，不想跟我解除婚约。”夏暮指尖下意识收紧，唇角，却是弯起一抹微不可察的嘲讽弧度。

薄璟琛向来如此，明明不爱她，却也不允许她真的背叛他。

只可惜，她现在已经玩腻了这场名为弃猫效应的游戏。

她的笑，彻底激怒了眼前的男人。

桎梏着她动作的大手，倏然松开。

“停车，调头，去苏小姐家。”薄璟琛的声音恢复了惯常的冷淡，像是刚才那一瞬间的情绪波动从未发生过。

车在路边停稳。

夏暮没有任何犹豫，推开车门就走了下去。

夜风灌进来，薄璟琛闻见那缕苦橘香气被风吹散，消失在车门合上的瞬间。

他盯着她头也不回的背影，等她回头看。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

She didn't want Bo Jingchen to know about her affair with Huo Yannian, not because she felt guilty.

Even at the beginning, she had no intention of hiding it from this man. If he had the intention to investigate, he would know that she did not come out of Huo Yannian's room that night.

However, the person in front of her was so confident that she felt that she would never accept anyone other than him.

The big hand holding her wrist was burning.

As if to remind her, how terrible it is for an inexplicable person like Bo Jingchen to go crazy.

Before the engagement was successfully terminated, she didn't want to anger him anymore because of these unknown things and cause trouble in her life.

"Bo Jingchen! Look clearly, I am not Su Ran."

Xia Mu suppressed the violent heartbeat in her chest.

She heard her pretending to be calm voice, but it was still a little trembling due to anxiety.

It seems that Su Ran's name is too useful.

When Xia Mu finished speaking, Bo Jingchen stopped in place while tugging on her collar.

But soon, he reacted again and gradually moved closer to her.

His big hands clasped her neck, forcing her to keep raising her eyes to meet his eyes.

She watched helplessly as this face, which had appeared in her dreams countless times, approached her.

The distance was so close that the tip of his nose was almost touching the tip of her nose.

Even though she has completely given up on the person in front of her.

But the breath of mint that gradually invaded her nasal cavity was still overbearing and strong, pulling her memories back to the past days and nights.

Xia Mu held her breath, and just about to use up her last bit of reason, she pushed away Bo Jingchen, whose eyes became increasingly gloomy.

There was no time to wait for her to make a move.

This time, Bo Jingchen sneered first and said, "Do you think that if I send you home once, you will have the confidence to challenge me?"

The pleasant and hoarse male voice turned into the sharpest blade, piercing her heart fiercely.

A short sentence is enough to make people fall from the warmth of spring into the depths of winter that will never be restored.

"Bo Jingchen, if you act like this, you will make me think that you are really in love with me and don't want to break off the engagement with me." Xia Mu's fingertips subconsciously tightened, but the corners of her lips curved into an imperceptible arc of ridicule.

Bo Jingchen has always been like this, even though he doesn't love her, he doesn't allow her to betray him.

Unfortunately, she is now tired of playing this game called the Abandoned Cat Effect.

Her smile completely angered the man in front of her.

The big hand that restrained her movements suddenly let go.

"Stop the car, make a U-turn, and go to Miss Su's house." Bo Jingchen's voice returned to its usual coldness, as if the mood swings at that moment had never happened.

The car stopped on the side of the road.

Xia Mu didn't hesitate, opened the car door and walked out.

The night wind blew in, and Bo Jingchen smelled the bitter orange aroma that was blown away by the wind and disappeared the moment the car door closed.

He stared at her back without looking back, waiting for her to look back.
